description: Image Description: The image shows a small white fishing boat moving through choppy, dark gray water. The boat is equipped with various fishing gear and supplies, including rods mounted on the back, a blue cooler, and several containers and equipment stored on deck. A red lifebuoy is mounted on the roof of the cabin, and another orange lifebuoy is visible near the stern. The boat has a registration number "HT 76707" displayed prominently on the front of the cabin
